content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question. Using an older [product_name] controller with a KNX communication module, I’ve linked a virtual logical input to a KNX group address, such as 1/1/1. When I set the group address 1/1/1 to local 1, the virtual input reflects logical 1—this part works fine. My challenge is, after starting a program via this virtual input going to logical 1, I'd like to reset this virtual input (same KNX group address 1/1/1) back to logical 0 from within the software. I’m not sure how to accomplish this in the [product_name] software. Can anyone provide guidance? Thanks in advance!

Hi, The older KNX module communicated through inputs and outputs with the [product_name] controller. To control digital signals from [product_name] to KNX, you need to use outputs that aren’t physically present on the controller. If you’ve already used all available digital outputs on [product_name], controlling additional digital signals to KNX isn't possible. I’m not certain whether group address 1/1/1 can be managed by two separate signals. Hope this information is helpful.

Hello, Thank you for your response. I’m unsure whether it’s possible to programmatically change a virtual input from within the [product_name] application. After searching online, I’ve found very few KNX examples for these older systems. Thanks and best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering challenges with legacy [product_name] controllers and their KNX communication modules, particularly regarding controlling virtual logical inputs associated with KNX group addresses. The primary issue is figuring out how to reset a virtual input, once set remotely via KNX, back to logical 0 from within the [product_name] application. There’s a lack of documentation and working examples for older systems, making solutions difficult to find without further assistance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to programmatically reset or manage the state of a virtual KNX input using the [product_name] application, and are seeking clear instructions or examples to achieve this with older [product_name] setups.
